_about: The day's work (Docs/fable-audit-2026-11.md, 7.3, the work practice): the tasks offered at the work beat (quiet.BEATS), each taken by one person a day. `label` is the choice as it is offered; `did` and `doing` are how the record and the room tell it. `hazard` names a chance in content/chances.json: work that can hurt.

boards.label: go round the boards on the windows and the door
boards.did: went round the boards on the windows and the door

water.label: carry the water in and measure what is left
water.did: carried the water in and measured what was left

watch.label: keep watch for a while at the gap in the boards
watch.did: kept watch at the gap in the boards
watch.doing: keeping watch at the gap in the boards
